responsibility: Implements GCC’s scalar-evolution analysis over SSA and loop nests. It derives CHREC-based evolution functions for scalar names, instantiates symbolic parameters, reasons about loop exits and iteration counts, supports induction-variable queries and inner-loop effect computation, and performs final-value replacement by moving provably computable post-loop values out of loop exit PHIs into explicit exit-block computations.
same_name_distinction: Implements scalar-evolution analysis and transformations, including deriving CHREC evolutions, loop-exit/iteration reasoning, and final-value replacement. Unlike the header, this file performs the analysis and rewriting rather than just declaring SCEV query and lifecycle APIs.
